nodes.name: Prepare handoff action
nodes.notes: The signed action body contains only eventId and organizationId. runId remains internal for the normal callback.

nodes.name: Sign handoff action
nodes.notes: Select the Crypto credential whose HMAC secret matches N8N_CALLBACK_SECRET. The signature covers timestamp.rawBody.

nodes.name: Request Vantix handoff alert
nodes.notes: VantixApp resolves recipients and the approved Meta template, sends through its own WhatsApp integration, and enforces idempotency.

nodes.name: Sign success callback
nodes.notes: Select the Crypto credential whose HMAC secret matches N8N_CALLBACK_SECRET.
